description: This file defines the main page component of a Next.js React application for managing personal notes. It includes authentication checks, fetching and displaying notes, and handling note CRUD operations through API calls. The component composes several UI components such as Header, Sidebar, and NoteEditor.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleSelectNote
methods.description: Handles user selection of a note, updating the selected note ID.

methods.name: handleCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via API and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves changes to the current note via API and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note via API and updates the application state.
